name: Boundary-structure-aware transfer function
definition: A classification method that computes the standard deviation of ambient occlusion ($O_{std}$) to address limitations of the occlusion spectrum where occlusion values overlap for objects with same intensity but different sizes, distances, or shapes.
summary: Boundary-structure-aware transfer functions classify volume data by combining intensity with the standard deviation of ambient occlusion to distinguish objects sharing similar intensities but differing in global structure or location.
